description: Can a European company receive an electronic invoice today, through which Peppol participants and formats, and which national e-invoicing mandate applies to it from which date? Give a French SIREN or SIRET, an intra-EU VAT number, a national company number with its country (BE KBO, NL KvK, IT P.IVA, DE), or a company name and country. The Peppol Directory is queried by free text and by exact participant on every scheme plausible for the country (a French SIREN is registered under 0225 SIREN_routing, not 0002), results merged; document types mapped to capabilities (BIS Billing invoice and credit note, CII, Factur-X, PINT, order) with a can_receive_einvoice verdict; identity from Sirene/RNE (FR) or VIES; mandate calendar with its official source. 0.005 USDC per call, charged only if the company is found (not on Peppol is a 200, registered:false).

company.description: Company name, with country (the closest Peppol entity name is kept)

company_id.description: National company number (BE KBO 0417497106, NL KvK 24330087, IT Partita IVA...), with country

country.description: ISO-2 EU/EEA country, required with company_id and company (FR, BE, NL, DE, IT, ES, PL...)

siren.description: French SIREN (9 digits) or SIRET (14 digits)

vat.description: Intra-EU VAT number with country prefix, e.g. FR27552032534, BE0417497106, NL810433941B01

name: einvoice_readiness
